subject: Upgrade sprint kickoff & QBR availability — Olive Systems renewal
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@olive-sys.com>, Olive Systems <info@olive-sys.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upgrade sprint kickoff & QBR availability — Olive Systems renewal

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the productive run-rate review last month. Per our conversation, we’re putting together a short kickoff to align on the renewal path, the proposed term adjustment (move to an 18-month commitment), and the capacity uplift you signaled (approx. +40% token throughput across embeddings and generation routes).

High-level proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week 1 (Jun 9–13): Contract SOW + legal redlines (procurement looped)
- Week 2 (Jun 16–20): Technical kickoff — capacity sizing & autoscaling plan (Redwood infra + Olive traffic patterns)
- Week 3 (Jun 23–27): Exec QBR readout & sign-off

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the procurement/legal contact who will own contract redlines (I’ve CC’d procurement here).
2) Which of these QBR windows work for your execs?
   - Jun 18 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Jun 19 14:00–15:00 PT
   - Jun 24 09:00–10:00 PT

I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan and a draft SOW for your review. Internally I’ve added Naomi (customer success lead), Connor (solutions/ops), and Marissa (renewal exec) so we can move fast. Karthik — would you and your infra team be available for the Week 2 technical kickoff?

Next steps from our side: we’ll prepare a short capacity runbook and a delta-cost estimate once we confirm the target throughput.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (plan + milestones), SOW-draft_Olive-Upgrade.docx (draft)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@olive-sys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@olive-sys.com>
Date: 2025-06-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upgrade sprint kickoff & QBR availability — Olive Systems renewal

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear plan. Jun 19 14:00–15:00 PT is our preferred QBR slot; Jun 18 would be tight for our CTO.

Procurement here is procurement@olive-sys.com (looped). They’ll need the SOC 2 evidence and a short data-flow diagram to start legal review — can your security team provide a one-pager?

Two quick clarifications:
- The +40% throughput is our internal ask (spikes anticipated during month-end reconciliations). Can you call out burst capacity and a price band for 200M–300M tokens/month?
- We may need a 30-day pilot of the higher throughput before committing the longer term — is that something Redwood supports (short pilot before 18-month term finalization)?

Thanks — I’ll hold the Jun 19 slot tentatively and confirm once procurement confirms availability.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Platform Integrations | Olive Systems
daniel.park@olive-sys.com | +1 212-555-0130

Thanks Stephanie — and hi Daniel.

We can provide the SOC 2 summary + a one-page diagram; I’ll pull that together with Security and have it to procurement by EOD Jun 3. Connor will scope the burst profile and cost bands (200M–300M tokens); Karthik, can you plan to join the technical kickoff in Week 2 to discuss autoscaling and KV cache behavior for embeddings-heavy traffic?

On the pilot ask: we frequently do a 30-day ramp with dedicated burst gates for customers transitioning between tiers — happy to propose a pilot plan (objectives, success metrics, rollback) in the Mutual Action Plan v1. If that’s acceptable, I’ll add the pilot section and a minimal runbook.

Connor — can you attach the capacity delta worksheet to the MAP and SOW once ready?

Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Stephanie / Naomi —

Jun 19 14:00–15:00 PT works; procurement confirmed they can attend that week and would like the SOC 2 summary by Jun 3.

We’re good to pilot the +40% uplift under a 30-day ramp provided we have:
- A written rollback trigger (error rate or latency thresholds)
- A ballpark pilot cost estimate (Connor, if you can send a 1-page cost band by EOD Jun 3 that would help us fast-track approvals)

Locking the Jun 19 slot on my calendar — I’ll send a calendar RSVP once we have the official invite.

Thanks,
Daniel
